entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns', 'Technical Support', or 'New Order'.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I need to return something. I think. The website was very confusing. I have an order number if that helps?
Of course, I can certainly help with that. Could you please provide me with the order number?
Okay, it's VF-886-11-2025. It's for some mountain bike shoes.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit XT-Pro Mountain Bike Shoes, delivered about 52 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I'm... not sure? I tried them once. The whole system with the pedals and the cleats is just too much for me, and I got terrible blisters on my heels. I just want to send these cycling shoes back. Can't you just help me get a refund?
I'm very sorry to hear the shoes weren't comfortable and caused blisters. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, I've confirmed it. You are well within our 90-day return window for these shoes.
Oh, really? So I can send them back? The policy page was so complicated, I thought I was stuck with them.

Yes, absolutely. Since you're within the 90 days, we can process a full refund for you. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive the shoes, the refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Wow, that's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Diana. You made that so much easier.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
